～Chapter 8～
The Final Regalia

Is everyone here?
Then let’s begin.
The last piece of the Regalia, the mirror, lies within the Sacred Demon Castle.
So all’s we gotta do is bust in a grab the mirror, yeah? No sweat.
All that’s left to do is keep moving forward without wavering.
But the demons ahead are likely to be even stronger.
We should make sure we’re optimally equipped...
An apple a day is worth a pound of cure!
That’s “An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure,” Orihime...
<NAME>, the final Regalia is within arm’s reach.
Steel yourself, and good luck.
Good luck, <NAME>!!
Alright, <NAME>, move out and retrieve the Pandemonium Regalia mirror!
